adjudication.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, feed items are parsed and `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` is passed directly to `TopicEmbed.import`. In `TopicEmbed.import`, the created post uses `PostCreator.new(... raw: absolutize_urls(url, contents), skip_validations: true, cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html])`, and `Post#cook` returns `raw` when `cook_method` is `:raw_html`, explicitly skipping the rendering/sanitization pipeline. The embed view then outputs it via `<%= raw post.cooked %>`. This diff therefore introduces a path where HTML from an admin-configured feed can be stored and served unsanitized, enabling stored XSS if that feed content is malicious/compromised.
